failures.summary: UF-03 and UF-11 timed out inside application.launch after all four bounded cooperative activation retries

observed: The bounded owner-aware recovery preserved its retry budget and user-focus safeguards, but NSApplication.activate() did not make the product foreground in either selected test.
interpretation: Bounded timing alone is insufficient. Delayed recovery attempts need the AppKit activation call that explicitly activates regardless of other applications while retaining foreground-owner relinquishment.
nextEvidenceNeeded: Repeat focused UF-03 and UF-11 against delayed recovery attempts using NSApplication.activate(ignoringOtherApps: true), then run the complete plan only if both pass.
